subject: Early invoice pre-auth, PO flagging, and discount trigger - AsterHealth
messages:
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@asterhealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@asterhealth.com
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO format / net75 request and early invoice for milestone 1

Hi Tessa,

Hope you had a good week. We're ready to move forward with Phase 1 but Procurement has a couple of constraints we need to capture before routing the PO:

- Net terms: standard request is net75 for our vendors (we understand this is outside Redwood's published terms).
- Invoice cadence: preferred is monthly consolidated invoices; however for milestone-based work we may request an early invoice for the first milestone to align with internal project funding.
- PO formatting: we require a PO flag called "PREAUTH_INV" if the vendor will invoice prior to milestone completion (this is a gating field for our AP system).

Also, our finance team tied the 10% onboarding discount to the PO including the vendor's commitment ID in the header (CommitID: AH-ONB-2026). If Redwood needs a formal change order or signature on the SOW to apply that discount, please confirm.

I've attached the draft PO we plan to issue pending confirmation of terms. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept a PO with a PREAUTH_INV flag and whether you can accept net75 or need a shortened netterm? If net75 is a hard blocker for you, let us know what alternatives (prepay, milestone invoicing, or partial retainers) you can accept.

Thanks,
Jordan
Procurement Manager, AsterHealth
Procurement Team: procurement@asterhealth.com

Attachment: PO_98765.pdf (PDF, 72KB)

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@asterhealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO format / net75 request and early invoice for milestone 1

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the clear summary and the draft PO. Short answer: we can make this work but need a small set of guardrails so it aligns with our billing/credit policy. Proposed compromise below:

1) Net terms: Redwood standard is net45. We can accept net75 for this enterprise engagement if: (a) the PO is a multi-month commitment (>= 6 months OR a minimum committed $ value), and (b) AsterHealth signs the SOW with the CommitID in the header.

2) PREAUTH_INV flag: we can honor a PREAUTH_INV PO flag for a one-time early invoice (Milestone 1 only) provided Redwood receives a signed SOW referencing AH-ONB-2026 AND the PO includes the PREAUTH_INV field. We will mark the invoice as "early-milestone" on our side for AP reconciliation.

3) Invoice cadence: monthly consolidated invoices are fine for ongoing billing after Milestone 1. For the first milestone Redwood will issue a separate early invoice upon execution because of your funding timing.

4) Discount trigger: We'll need the CommitID on both the signed SOW and PO header. Finance will apply the 10% onboarding discount in the first invoice only.

I'll loop in Ben (Finance) and Vanessa (AE) to make sure the accounting and commercial approvals are captured. I'm attaching a PO template with the PREAUTH_INV field and a redlined SOW note to make the process frictionless.

Next steps: if you can sign/return the SOW with CommitID AH-ONB-2026 and issue the PO with PREAUTH_INV, Ben can provision the discount and we will generate the early milestone invoice.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx (Excel, 18KB); SOW-AsterHealth-Phase1.pdf (PDF, 145KB)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@asterhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO format / net75 request and early invoice for milestone 1

Looping Ben for finance approval. Ben — quick context: AsterHealth wants net75 and an early invoice for Milestone 1. Tessa's proposed guardrails require signed SOW + CommitID and a PREAUTH_INV PO flag. Can Finance accept the onboarding discount (10%) on an early invoice and stretch payment to net75 given that the engagement is committed for 12 months and the PO value meets the threshold? If you need a short contract/commitment ID mapping to book revenue, I can get legal to add a brief clause.

Ben — if you confirm, I'll send Jordan a one-line confirmation to proceed.

—Vanessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Tessa / Vanessa / Ben —

Thanks — this is helpful. AsterHealth confirms:

- We will sign the SOW and ensure CommitID AH-ONB-2026 appears in the SOW header.
- Procurement will issue PO_98765.pdf with PREAUTH_INV set to TRUE and will route it once we have your one-line confirmation that net75 + early invoice is acceptable under the conditions described.
- We prefer the 10% onboarding discount applied to the early invoice (first invoice) as discussed.

Attached is the PO in its official format; we will issue it to Redwood once Ben confirms the discount and net75 handling. If Finance needs a brief booking note or a counter-signed SOW to process, please let us know and we'll expedite.

Appreciate the quick coordination — looking forward to getting the first invoice out next week so the project can hit the funding milestone.

Best,
Jordan
